title: Create Maximum Number
description: Create the maximum number of length k from two arrays nums1 and nums2 by maintaining relative order.

steps.note: Starting loop to determine how many elements to pick from nums1.
Extracting maximum subsequence of length 0 from nums1.
Extracting maximum subsequence of length 3 from nums2.
Merging subsequences [ ] and [9, 8, 3] to form candidate.
Incrementing i to pick 1 element from nums1.
Extracting max subsequence of length 2 from nums2.
